searchText: I adjusted the Verkle tree spec and my proposed gas cost change EIP: https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/proposed-verkle-tree-scheme-for-ethereum-state/5805 https://notes.ethereum.org/4BPLDyGnQ0WY12kVbOuvxw New highlights: * Width 8 * Bottom layer is now a single layer of commitments, so the tree structure is a clean tree-of-commitments * Gas costs per code chunk reduced from 350 to 200 (or 175 if pre-declared) * Header, 64 storage slots and 128 code chunks are all packed into one subtree, so small contracts get *very* favorable gas treatment

excerpts.content: I adjusted  the Verkle tree spec and my proposed gas cost change EIP:

excerpts.author: .vbuterin
excerpts.content:
* Width 8
* Bottom layer is now a single layer of commitments, so the tree structure is a clean tree-of-commitments
* Gas costs per code chunk reduced from 350 to 200 (or 175 if pre-declared)
* Header, 64 storage slots and 128 code chunks are all packed into one subtree, so small contracts get *very* favorable gas treatment
